title: Systematic Evaluation of Neural Retrieval Models on the Touché 2020 Argument Retrieval Subset of BEIR
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical effectiveness and reproducibility of neural information retrieval models. While it evaluates models on a dataset of arguments concerning controversial social topics, the evaluation is based on standard retrieval metrics (nDCG@10) and does not include a component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
